answer: Before first payout, the holder joins a calligraphy guild and writes one page with a quill in violet ink on timber bark paper, the guild signing it. Two verifiers match the page against the guild's register within a week; a page claimed twice, or strokes matching no member, closes both. A guild course costs 2 million rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand and 2 billion. The timber bark carries the violet line.
